threat_event: Ransomware delivered by phishing on a field office PC spreads across the flat network and encrypts the SCADA host and its attached USB backup
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Flat field office network; saved remote desktop shortcut from the shared field desktop to the SCADA host; no staff training; no after-hours alerting
existing_controls: MFA on email; MSP antivirus on office computers; hardwired safety shutdowns
treatment_plan: Small firewall separating the SCADA host and radio base from field PCs and Wi-Fi; remove the remote desktop shortcut; training and phishing exercises; MSP-managed EDR with after-hours alerts

threat_event: Attacker uses the SCADA integrator's always-on remote access tool to operate the HMI and change the SWD pressure or pump-off setpoints
threat_source: Cybercriminal or hacktivist using stolen vendor credentials
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: One shared integrator account; no MFA; no session record; tool always running on the SCADA host
treatment_plan: Remove the always-on tool; vendor sessions only through an MFA-protected tool that the Field Superintendent enables per session, with a session log; named integrator accounts

threat_event: SCADA host is lost to ransomware or hardware failure and cannot be rebuilt in time because its only backup is lost with it
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Weekly backup to a USB drive that stays attached; controller programs only on the engineering laptop; never restore-tested; integrator needs 2 to 3 days without a good backup
existing_controls: Weekly USB copy; manual operations procedure
treatment_plan: Two encrypted USB drives rotated weekly (one kept at the main office); controller programs copied to the shared drive after each change; SCADA host added to the MSP's cloud backup with immutable retention; quarterly restore test on a spare PC

threat_event: Business email compromise changes a royalty owner's or vendor's bank account so a payment goes to an attacker
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Owner bank detail changes accepted by email without a call-back; no phishing training
existing_controls: MFA on email and production accounting; bank dual approval of each ACH batch
treatment_plan: Call-back to a number on file before any bank detail change (POL-04 4.7); monthly report of changed owner bank details reviewed by the Owner; training

threat_event: Royalty owner personal information (names with Social Security and bank account numbers) is stolen from exports in email and on laptops
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Exports emailed as plain attachments and saved on laptops; no inventory of where owner data sits
treatment_plan: Use the production accounting portal or encrypted send instead of attachments; delete local exports monthly; list where owner data is kept (POL-04 4.4)

threat_event: Attacker exploits a known vulnerability in the unsupported SCADA host operating system
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Operating system past end of vendor support; not patched since 2024; signature antivirus only
existing_controls: Field office locked; no internet browsing policy (not enforced)
treatment_plan: Replacement SCADA host on a supported operating system installed by the integrator; MSP patching and EDR after SCADA vendor approval

threat_event: Former employee or contractor uses access that was never removed (mobile viewer, HMI password, Wi-Fi, gate code)
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No termination checklist beyond email; shared HMI password unchanged since 2019; mobile viewer account active 4 months after a departure; no MFA on the mobile viewer
existing_controls: Account disabled 2026-07-22 when found; viewer log showed no use
treatment_plan: Last-day checklist covering every system, shared password, Wi-Fi, and gate code; quarterly account review; MFA on the mobile viewer

threat_event: A harmful HMI command cannot be traced to a person because all field staff share one login
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Shared operator login; no sign-in sheet; operator log names only the shared account
treatment_plan: Named HMI accounts for the Field Technician and integrator; sign-in sheet at the HMI for Lease Operators; monthly operator log review

threat_event: A mistaken or unapproved controller program change alters an SWD high-pressure setting or pump-off logic
threat_source: Field Technician, integrator, or SCADA vendor (process error)
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No change approval or record; no saved baseline copy of each controller program
treatment_plan: One-page OT change log approved by the Field Superintendent; program copy saved before and after each change

threat_event: A known vulnerability in controller, radio, or modem firmware stays unpatched because nobody knows the models and versions; radio messages have no authentication
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No OT inventory; licensed radio without message authentication; modems on the carrier's private network
existing_controls: Private radio license; modems on the carrier's private network
treatment_plan: OT inventory with models and firmware; monthly check of advisories for those models; radio authentication reviewed at the next radio replacement

threat_event: An intrusion into the field office network or a SaaS account goes unnoticed for weeks
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No log review; SCADA event log overwrites; antivirus alerts reach the MSP only in business hours
treatment_plan: Monthly log review checklist; MSP-managed EDR with after-hours alerts; SCADA event log size increased

threat_event: Hurricane closes the field office and main office for several days
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: SCADA host and radio base in one field office with a 30-minute UPS and no generator; no cyber contingency plan
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-01; SYS-02; SYS-06; BP-01 to BP-05
existing_controls: Pre-storm shut-in procedure in the emergency response plan; SaaS reachable from anywhere
treatment_plan: Add a SCADA section to the pre-storm checklist (take the rotated backup drive off site, shut down the host cleanly); restart checklist after the storm

threat_event: Production accounting SaaS outage at month-end delays royalty payments
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Single SaaS dependency for allocations and royalties
treatment_plan: Accepted: the vendor's RTO of 24 hours is inside the 120-hour BIA target; owners can be told of a short delay

threat_event: Breach at the production accounting vendor exposes royalty owner personal information
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Contract has no breach notice or cooperation term; company relies on the vendor's controls
treatment_plan: Add 72-hour breach notice and cooperation terms at renewal; annual SOC 2 review

threat_event: A compromised SCADA software update or the integrator's own laptop brings malware onto the SCADA host
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Updates applied without checking their source or hash; integrator laptops connect to the field office network without checks
treatment_plan: Updates only from the vendor's site with hash checks; visiting laptops scanned by the MSP or kept off the SCADA side of the new firewall

threat_event: A lost or stolen company smartphone exposes email and the SCADA mobile viewer
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Phones travel with field staff every day
existing_controls: MDM passcode, encryption, and remote wipe; mobile viewer is view and acknowledge only
treatment_plan: Accepted: MDM controls and the view-only viewer keep the residual risk Low; MFA on the viewer (R-007) reduces it further

threat_event: An infected USB drive or the unmanaged engineering laptop spreads malware to the SCADA host
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: USB ports open on the SCADA host; engineering laptop has no MSP agent and an administrator account
existing_controls: Signature antivirus on the SCADA host (updated by hand)
treatment_plan: Engineering laptop enrolled with the MSP (antivirus, patching, standard user); USB storage blocked on the SCADA host except one scanned company drive

threat_event: Licensed seismic data or reservoir interpretations are copied by a departing employee or exposed through the open Geology folder
threat_source: Workforce member or outsider with a staff account
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Geology folder open to all 7 staff; license limits access to named users; no download alerts
treatment_plan: Restrict the folder to the Owner and named users in the license; quarterly permission check; share with partners only through dated links

threat_event: During a cyber incident staff do not know whether to disconnect SCADA, so wells are shut in unnecessarily or SCADA stays connected too long
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No incident response plan; emergency response plan has no cyber section; no tabletop
existing_controls: Emergency response plan with manual operations
treatment_plan: POL-03 and the P08 runbook; isolation decision table at the field office; tabletop with the MSP and the integrator

threat_event: Only the Field Technician and the integrator can rebuild the SCADA configuration and controller programs
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No written rebuild procedure; programs only on one laptop; integrator has no service commitment
treatment_plan: Written rebuild procedure with the integrator; programs and license keys in the rotated backup set; Field Superintendent trained on the restore steps

threat_event: Cyber insurance claim disputed because remote access lacked MFA and backups were not offline as the application stated
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Application answers did not match practice for vendor remote access and SCADA backups
treatment_plan: Close R-002 and R-003; tell the broker in writing what changed and when; correct answers at renewal

threat_event: The predictive maintenance add-on changes pump-off settings on its own, or misses failures while staff stop checking
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Vendor turned on write-back for 2 pilot wells without approval; no contract terms on data use or feature changes
existing_controls: Lease Operators still visit every well daily
treatment_plan: Write-back off (done 2026-08-26) and checked monthly; advisory use only; vendor terms on data use and change notice (see P10)

threat_event: Staff paste royalty owner data or licensed seismic data into public generative AI tools
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No approved-tools list before 2026-08-31
treatment_plan: Approved-tools rule in POL-04 4.6; covered in annual training

threat_event: Power or internet outage at the field office silences after-hours alarm call-out
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 30-minute UPS; no generator; one internet line; call-out depends on the SCADA host reaching the vendor cloud
existing_controls: Vendor service sends a 'connector offline' text after 15 minutes
treatment_plan: On-call Lease Operator starts 2-hour patrols when the offline text arrives; cellular backup for the field office internet line

threat_event: Internet scanners find the remote desktop port forwarded to the SCADA host and log in or exploit it
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Port forward on the field office router set up by the integrator in 2022; unsupported operating system on the host
treatment_plan: Port forward removed 2026-08-11; rescan 2026-08-12 confirmed closed; quarterly external scan by the MSP; router changes only through the OT change log
